steps.title: The idea
steps.body: A rook and king can also force checkmate. A key idea is to cut the enemy king off with the rook, so it cannot cross to your side.

steps.title: Cutting off the king
steps.body: Ra5 cuts the black king off from the fifth rank. The king can no longer cross to your side of the board.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.body: Cut the king off on the fifth rank. Play the rook to a5.
steps.hint: The rook goes to the fifth rank, one row above the king.
steps.success: Yes. The enemy king is cut off on one side.

steps.question: What is a key idea when using a rook in an endgame?
steps.explanation: A rook that cuts off the king's path makes the rest of the mate much easier.
